meta.priceNote: Prices are as listed on 28 October 2026 and are unconfirmed until an official invoice.
meta.author: Josef Yang, JC2
meta.importNote: excluding shipping and import tax; warranty claims go to China
meta.importText: These ship from China. Shipping, import tax, voltage (choose the 220–240 V model) and warranty claims back to China are all unquoted. All three ship with a hardened-steel bimetal nozzle and hardened-steel extruder gears, so carbon fibre needs no extra parts. QIDI is one of the best for our school use case, but it must be imported. They offer good import services and consultation, so it is an option that should be considered.

printers.name: Anycubic Kobra S1 Max
printers.reason: Largest heated build in the local tier
printers.summary: About 35 cm of print space, so a whole chassis part prints in one piece. Heated and enclosed inside, with a nozzle built for tough materials.
printers.tradeOff: Draws about 2,200 W, so the room's power circuit must be checked first. The shop page says limited stock.
printers.colourSystem: optional colour system (ACE 2 Pro) sold separately, not in the quoted price
printers.standout: Largest build volume with a heated chamber in the local tier (42.9 L)

sources.label: Anycubic Kobra S1 Max Combo manufacturer page
3D Zaiku product page and one-year parts warranty

printers.name: Creality K2 Pro
printers.reason: Dual AI cameras watch for failed prints
printers.summary: A 30 cm enclosed printer with an active heated chamber. Two AI cameras watch for failed prints, which matters when a teacher cannot stand next to it.
printers.tradeOff: Users report a hardened nozzle is not fitted natively, so watch nozzle durability. The warranty covers parts only.
printers.colourSystem: optional colour system (CFS) sold separately, not in the quoted price
printers.nozzle: Hardened steel 0.4 mm in the listing (also 0.2 / 0.6 / 0.8); the Docs table says copper alloy with a hardened tip
printers.filaments: PLA-CF listed for the colour system
printers.standout: Dual AI cameras watch for failed prints
printers.watchOut: Nozzle not fitted natively per users; warranty covers parts only

sources.label: Creality K2 Pro review, Tom's Hardware
Creality K2 Pro, LDLC product page

printers.name: Flashforge Creator 5 Pro
printers.reason: Four toolheads and HEPA13 air filtering
printers.summary: Four independent toolheads swap materials with no purge waste, and HEPA13 plus carbon filtering is the strongest air protection in the local tier.
printers.tradeOff: Harder to maintain. Printing speed is 300 mm/s; the 600 mm/s figure is travel only.
printers.filaments: PA-CF, PET-CF, PPS-CF and others (list not stated in full)
printers.standout: 4 toolheads swap materials with no purge waste; HEPA13 + carbon

sources.label: Flashforge Creator 5 and 5 Pro launch coverage

printers.name: Bambu Lab P2S (refurbished)
printers.summary: Refurbished by Bambu. Ready in under 15 minutes, with AI oversight and phone monitoring.
printers.tradeOff: Spare parts are hard to source (proprietary) and it is less reliable for engineering-grade filament. Refurbished, but the warranty covers it.
printers.speedNote: typically under 400 mm/s in real use
printers.nozzleNote: A stainless nozzle is not bad for everyday printing but wears faster on carbon fibre, so budget for a replacement nozzle.
printers.standout: Ready in under 15 minutes, AI oversight, phone monitoring
printers.watchOut: Spare parts hard to source (proprietary); less reliable for engineering-grade filament

printers.name: Creality K1 Max
printers.bestFor: 30 cm builds on a lower budget
printers.summary: A 300 mm build at the third-lowest local price, with a camera and an air purifier.
printers.tradeOff: No active chamber, so large nylon-carbon parts may warp. Less reliable for engineering-grade filament.
printers.nozzle: Not stated by 3D Zaiku; a hardened nozzle can be fitted
printers.nozzleNote: Can take a third-party hardened nozzle (BROZZL at 3DJake) but stays limited by a 300 °C hotend and no active chamber.
printers.standout: 300 mm build at the third-lowest local price, camera and air purifier
printers.watchOut: No active chamber, large nylon-carbon may warp; less reliable for engineering-grade filament

printers.name: Elegoo Centauri Carbon
printers.summary: The lowest price on the list, sold by 3D Zaiku as the official Elegoo distributor.
printers.tradeOff: Smallest build and no heated chamber. Very unreliable for engineering-grade or any hardened filament; durability questionable.
printers.nozzle: Hardened-steel dual-gear extruder; nozzle not described
printers.filaments: PLA-CF recommended; PETG-CF, ABS-CF, ASA-CF, PET-CF, PA-CF listed as compatible
printers.nozzleNote: Lists a hardened-steel dual-gear extruder but no active chamber.
printers.standout: Lowest price; 3D Zaiku is the official Elegoo distributor
printers.watchOut: Smallest build, no heated chamber; very unreliable for engineering-grade or any hardened filament; durability questionable

printers.name: Bambu Lab P1S
printers.bestFor: Fast setup, same workflow as P2S
printers.summary: New. Setup takes under 15 minutes and it shares the P2S workflow.
printers.tradeOff: Smaller size, and the Bambu ecosystem is limiting for complex builds. Less reliable for engineering-grade filament.
printers.nozzleNote: A stainless nozzle is not bad for everyday printing but wears faster on carbon fibre, so budget for a replacement nozzle.
printers.standout: Setup under 15 minutes, same workflow as P2S
printers.watchOut: Smaller size; Bambu ecosystem limiting for complex builds; less reliable for engineering-grade filament

printers.name: Bambu Lab X1 Carbon
printers.summary: LiDAR inspects the first layer. The model is now retired.
printers.tradeOff: Proprietary spare parts and the model is retired. Less reliable for engineering-grade filament.
printers.watchOut: Proprietary spare parts; model is retired; less reliable for engineering-grade filament

printers.name: Bambu Lab X2D
printers.summary: The only Bambu with active chamber heating to 65 °C, a dual-nozzle toolhead with low waste (about 8 g) and 3-stage filtration with H12 HEPA.
printers.tradeOff: Smaller size, the ecosystem is limiting, and it is out of stock.
printers.standout: Only Bambu with active heating to 65 °C; low waste (about 8 g); 3-stage filtration with H12 HEPA
printers.watchOut: Smaller size; ecosystem limiting; out of stock

printers.name: QIDI Max4
printers.reason: Largest build volume in this list (51.7 L)
printers.summary: The largest build volume in this list, a 370 °C hotend and an evenly heated full bed, driven by closed-loop servo-style motors.
printers.tradeOff: It weighs 40 kg and must be imported. The Polar Cooler is a separate add-on.
printers.standout: Largest build volume in this list (51.7 L); closed-loop servo-style motors
printers.watchOut: 40 kg; Polar Cooler is a separate add-on

sources.label: QIDI Max4, QIDI international purchase site

printers.name: QIDI Plus5
printers.reason: Pick a model on a phone, send in one tap
printers.summary: A 32 cm heated-chamber printer with a 370 °C hotend. The QIDI Maker app lets a student pick a model on a phone and send it in one tap.
printers.tradeOff: Proprietary, non-quick-swap nozzle and a longer heat-up. Must be imported.
printers.standout: QIDI Maker app: pick a model on a phone, send in one tap

sources.label: QIDI Plus5, QIDI international purchase site
